newsitem.title: USA: HomeCapital says deal with Prudential terminated.
newsitem.headline: HomeCapital says deal with Prudential terminated.

text.p: HomeCapital Investment Corp said Thursday a plan for Prudential Securities Inc to finance and securitize Fannie Mae mortgage-backed securities of its wholly-owned subsidiary HomeOwners Mortgage & Equity Inc has been terminated.
HomeCapital said no adverse affect on the unit's current mortgage banking operations is expected. No reason for the termination was given.
The company said it recently concluded a repurchase agremeent with Fannie Mae that provices funding for FHA Title I home improvemnt laons and Fannie Mae mortgage-backed securities.

Homecapital said its unit currently has approximately $12.5 million of Fannie Mae mortgage-backed securities that are being funded under the repurchase arrangement with Fannie Mae. It said the management is considering other investment banking firms or secondary market participants to assist in implementing the securitization program.
HomeCapital said it hopes to issue asset-backed securities before the end of September.
